entries.title: Does an open-weight decision model beat a hosted one? Jev vs. Laya
entries.author: Jmeg8r
entries.candidateReason: matched "laya jev" (the comparison people keep making)
entries.ourNote: A first-person write-up of moving typed decisions onto a Mac Studio for privacy rather than for speed, with the gateway design and the fail-closed rules spelled out. Rare in this genre: the author says plainly that he did not test whether Laya beats Jev overall, which is why we quote his deployment rather than his opinion.

entries.title: Laya, an open decision model that plays Tetris by itself
entries.author: iamsyr
entries.ourNote: Laya playing Tetris by itself, posted as a Show HN. Three points, no comments, and it is still on this wall because the game loop is the clearest demonstration of what a 30 ms decision actually buys you — and because the same demo is what most of the model's traffic arrived through.
